annotations.title: Studio: send an image or clip

description: Adds one of the user’s own files to a project, to use in scripts as "midia/<nome>". Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 15 MB (best at the video’s size: 1920×1080 for 16:9, 1080×1920 for 9:16). Clips and the user’s own recordings (presenter "video"): MP4 or WebM up to 80 MB (720p is plenty; phone video works). With `url` (a public https link straight to the file) it is fetched now. Without it, returns a single-use upload link valid ~15 min in two forms: a page on avatar.diatech.solutions where the user drags the file in the browser (show that page to users of ChatGPT, claude.ai or any chat without a shell), and a PUT URL for agents with a shell (curl -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: video/mp4' --data-binary @file '<url>', with the file's own type). Same name again replaces the file. Only send what the user owns or may use. Free.

de.description: Reuse a file the user already sent to another of their projects (copied, nothing to upload): { projeto, nome } from studio_listar_midias with todas: true.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

url.description: Public https link straight to the file (optional; without it you get an upload URL).
